3234-3293-4693-8095.easyPrerequisites: You control a Plains or have a Plains in your graveyard.
3234-3293-4693-8095.description:
Activate Overgrown Estate by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 1 until you control no lands.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing World Shaper.
When World Shaper dies, it triggers, return all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning World Shaper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve all remaining Emeria Shepherd triggers.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat
3234-3293-4693-8095.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard and library to the battlefield if you control there are two or more Plains between your graveyard, library and battlefield. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

5571-6495-7046--6.description:
Use Iroh to give Blightbeetle to an opponent
Activate Evereth by sacrificing the undying creature.
When the undying creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to Blightbeetle.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat from step 2.
5571-6495-7046--6.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

2866-4247-4808-4986.description:
Cast Black Lotus by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Black Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Black Lotus from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

1981-2415-5256-5789.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-5256-5789.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Lifecreed Duo triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

5330-5777-7810.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Food.
5330-5777-7810.description:
Activate Atog by sacrificing a Food.
Camellia triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token and a Food artifact token.
Resolve the Atog ability
Repeat.

4574-4659-5034-6769-6842.notablePrerequisites: There must be at least one +1/+1 counter each on Arcbound Reclaimer and at least two additional artifacts.
4574-4659-5034-6769-6842.description:
Cast Sol Ring by paying its mana cost.
When Sol Ring enters, Surge Conductor triggers, putting one +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Reclaimer and at least two additional artfacts you control.
Activate Sol Ring by tapping it, adding mana.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Sol Ring, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Sol Ring from your graveyard on top of your library.
Activate Iron Spider's last ability by paying {2} and removing two +1/+1 counters from artifacts you control, drawing Sol Ring.
Repeat.

2103-7370-7487.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost.
Kykar triggers, exiling Zealous Lorecaster.
Resolve Capture of Jingzhou, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Kykar triggers, returning Zealous Lorecaster from exile to the battlefield.
When Zealous Lorecaster enters, it triggers, returning Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

4399-4518-6626-6719.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and The Wind Crystal.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Dazzling Angel triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Kor Skyfisher. When it enters, it and Dazzling Angel trigger.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Dazzling Angel trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
4399-4518-6626-6719.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Kor Skyfisher for the first time.

3946-5451-7705.description:
Play Glacial Chasm either from your hand or from your graveyard.
When Glacial Chasm enters the battlefield, its second ability triggers, causing you to sacrifice another land you control.
Play any land from your graveyard.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Glacial Chasm's cumulative upkeep ability triggers, allowing you to choose not to pay the cost and sacrifice it instead.
Repeat.

2528-4050-5088-7443-7537.notablePrerequisites:
You control eight or more lands.
Any one opponent cannot block and kill Emeritus of Abundance this turn.
2528-4050-5088-7443-7537.description:
Cast a copy of Regrowth from exile by paying {1}{G}, targeting any card besides the actual Regrowth.
Pyromancer's Ascension's first ability triggers, allowing you to put a quest counter on it.
Resolve the copy of Regrowth, returning that card from your graveyard to your hand.
Declare Emeritus of Abundance as an attacker.
When Emeritus of Abundance attacks, it triggers, becoming prepared.
During your second main phase, cast a copy of Regrowth by paying {1}{G}, targeting the actual Regrowth card.
Pyromancer Ascension's first ability triggers, allowing you to put a quest counter on it.
Resolve the copy of Regrowth, returning Regrowth from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Channel the Suns by paying its mana cost.
Pyromancer Ascension's second ability triggers, copying Channel the Suns.
Resolve both copies of Channel the Suns, adding mana.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Emeritus of Abundance, producing that card's result.
Cast the card Regrowth from your hand by paying {1}{G}, targeting Emeritus of Abundance.
Pyromancer Ascension's second ability triggers, copying Regrowth and allowing you to target Channel the Suns with the copy.
Resolve both copies of Regrowth, returning Emeritus of Abundance and Channel the Suns from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Channel the Suns by paying its mana cost.
Pyromancer Ascension's second ability triggers, copying Channel the Suns.
Resolve both copies of Channel the Suns, adding mana.
Cast Emeritus of Abundance by paying {2}{G}.
Cast a copy of Regrowth from exile by paying {1}{G}, targeting Channel the Suns.
Both of Pyromancer Ascension's abilities trigger.
In response, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Emeritus of Ideation, producing that card's result.
Resolve Pyromancer Ascension's first abiliity, putting a redundant quest counter on it if desired.
Resolve Pyromancer Ascension's second ability, copying Regrowth and targeting Emeritus of Abundance with the copy.
Repeat from step 15.

774-1362-2653.description:
Activate Patron of the Moon by paying {1}, putting Oboro, Palace in the Clouds from your hand onto the battlefield tapped.
When Oboro, Palace in the Clouds enters the battlefield, Nissa triggers, adding one mana of any color.
Activate Oboro's first ability by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Oboro's last ability by paying {1}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
774-1362-2653.notes: Nissa's ability will also find a single Elf or Elemental from your library and put it into your hand.

3532-5078-6769-7356.easyPrerequisites: There are at least two counters on creatures you control.
3532-5078-6769-7356.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Diving Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Longshot triggers, dealing 2 damage to each opponent.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters the battlefield, Surge Conductor triggers, putting a counter on a creature you control that already has a counter on it.
Repeat.

141-6747-7301.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two artifacts.
141-6747-7301.description:
Cast Avatar's Wrath by paying its mana cost, targeting Sami
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost reduced by Sami.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Avatar's Wrath targeting Sami
Resolve Avatar's Wrath, airbending Naru Meha.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha from exile by paying {0} due to Sami.
Repeat from step 3.

1399-1606-3457-7069.description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G} due to Tectonic Split
Activate Ley Weaver by tapping it, untapping Wirewood Lodge and a land
Activate Wirewood Lodge's second ability by paying {G} and tapping it, untapping Seeker of Skybreak.
Activate Seeker of Skybreak by tapping it, untapping Ley Weaver.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Grim Poppet and with toughness 2 or greater

2228-2719-3108.description:
Activate Grim Poppet by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, putting a -1/-1 counter on Sakashima of a Thousand Faces.
Hapatra triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Sakashima of a Thousand Faces by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, putting a -1/-1 counter on Grim Poppet.
Hapatra triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to Oracle of Mul Daya

573-4826-5449-5702.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn
573-4826-5449-5702.description:
Play Gruul Turf. When it enters untapped due to Archelos, Gruul Turf and Springheart Nantuko trigger.
Holding priority, activate Gruul Turf by tapping it, adding {R}{G}.
Resolve the Gruul Turf trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Oracle of Mul Daya.
Because of the additional Oracle of Mul Daya token, you can play an additional land this turn. 
Repeat.

1632-1987-2468-3094.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Panoptic Mirror triggers.
Holding priority, activate Stonespeaker Crystal by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Lithoform Engine's first ability by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Panoptic Mirror's trigger.
Resolve the copy of Panoptic Mirror's trigger, casting a copy of Ghostly Flicker without paying its mana cost.
Resolve the copy of Ghostly Flicker, blinking Stonespeaker Crystal and Lithoform Engine.
Repeat from step 2.

850-1323-4687.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three creatures with defender.
850-1323-4687.description:
Activate Experiment Kraj using Overgrown Battlement's ability by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Experiment Kraj using Gilder Bairn's ability by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on target permanent.
Repeat.

2196-2821-4249-5803.notablePrerequisites:
You are able to produce at least {5}{U} between Nykthos and up to one additional land.
Kitsa has power 2 or greater and does not have summoning sickness.
2196-2821-4249-5803.description:
Activate Nykthos and up to one other land by paying {2} and tapping them, adding at least {5}{U}.
Cast Frantic Search by paying {2}{U}.
Kitsa's prowess ability triggers, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Holding priority, activate Kitsa's second ability by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Frantic Search.
Resolve the copy of Frantic Search, causing you to loot twice and untap Minamo, Nykthos and up to one other land.
Activate Nykthos and up to one other land by paying {2} and tapping them, adding at least {5}{U}.
Activate Minamo's second ability by paying {U} and tapping it, untapping Kitsa.
Repeat from step 4.

804-1479-3147.description:
Play Azorius Chancery.
Kodama of the East Tree, Sakashima the Impostor, and Azorius Chancery trigger.
Resolve the Sakashima the Impostor trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Azorius Chancery trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting Azorius Chancery onto the battlefield.
Sakashima the Impostor and Azorius Chancery trigger.
Resolve the Azorius Chancery trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the Sakashima the Impostor token's trigger, putting Azorius Chancery onto the battlefield.
Kodama of the East Tree and Azorius Chancery trigger.
Repeat from step 5.

851-2316-5231.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two Goblins.
851-2316-5231.description:
Activate Goblin Warrens by paying {2}{R} and sacrificing two Goblins, creating six 1/1 Goblin creature tokens.
Activate Thermopod's second ability three times by sacrificing three Goblins, adding {2}{R}.
Repeat.

1308-2457-3129-5794.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating four 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate Baylen's first ability twice by tapping the four Insect tokens, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat.

486-4096-4407-4853.notablePrerequisites: Goblin Welder does not have summoning sickness.
486-4096-4407-4853.description:
Activate Liquimetal Torque's second ability by tapping it, causing Goblin Welder to become an artifact in addition to its other types until end of turn.
Activate Goblin Welder by tapping it, sacrificing Dross Scorpion and returning Unbender Tine from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Dross Scorpion triggers, untapping Goblin Welder.
Activate Unbender Tine by tapping it, targeting Goblin Welder.
Holding priority, activate Goblin Welder by tapping it, sacrificing Unbender Tine and returning Dross Scorpion from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Unbender Tine ability, untapping Goblin Welder.
Repeat from step 2.

1379-1628-3197-4659.notablePrerequisites:
Necrosynthesis attached to Herd Baloth.
You control an additional creature.
1379-1628-3197-4659.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing a creature, adding {C}{C}.
Necrosynthesis triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a 4/4 Beast creature token.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Beast token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 2.

1303-1769-5231.description:
Cast Rot Hulk by paying {5}{B}{B}.
When Rot Hulk enters, it and Necroduality trigger.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing Rot Hulk.
Resolve the Rot Hulk trigger, failing to return anything to the battlefield.
Resolve the Necroduality trigger, creating a token copy of Rot Hulk.
When the token Rot Hulk enters, it triggers, returning Rot Hulk from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1737-4853-5004-5231.description:
Activate Prototype Portal by paying {3} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Cathodion.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Cathodion, adding {R}.
When Cathodion dies, it and Dross Scorpion trigger.
Resolve the Cathodion trigger, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Dross Scorpion trigger, untapping Prototype Portal.
Repeat.

1463-2199-3096.description:
Activate Frenetic Efreet an arbitrarily large number of times, holding priority as you do so.
Allow Frenetic Efreet's activations to resolve, drawing a card from Zndrsplt per won coin flip.
This should draw out your library and Jace's replacement effect will have you win the game.
